legend.2: Sound and normal: develops a piece, defends, castles, or improves the position without changing material
legend.3: Strong: wins material safely, creates a serious threat the opponent must answer, or gains a clear advantage
legend.4: Decisive: delivers checkmate now, or forces a large material gain or an unstoppable mating attack
